Global Electrical Infrastructure Spending to Hit $32 Trillion by 2034

Global spending on electrical infrastructure is projected to reach $32 trillion over the next decade, driven by increasing electricity demand from artificial intelligence (AI), electrification, and industrial activity. This investment will cover power generation, grids, storage, and critical minerals, according to a report by UBS.
